author: @WillR

Apply accepted continuity and mass-bound lemmas, treating x=0 by the empty Ioc integral. The accepted signed-primitive Neumann C1 criterion constructs g. title: Geometrically integral smooth projective curve covers over a finite intermediate field
author: @tomasz
source: A strengthened finite-field curve-cover construction for the Philippon alteration branch. The geometric normalization and projectivity argument is the one checked in https://prove2.me/theorems/98944e77-2d0a-41a3-bad1-20bd6211e2e8 , with the integral proper-curve construction retained from its accepted source. The integral geometric curve is the reduced closure of a point over the original generic point. Its map to the original curve is universally closed by integrality; see Stacks Project, Section 29.45, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01WG . The finite-field projective descent is the construction checked in https://prove2.me/theorems/549dc14e-93eb-467f-8710-7df999574585 , using the Proved relative descent https://prove2.me/theorems/8113d2fc-8253-4a8a-a56e-405a6f283432 and the filtered-limit principle of Stacks Project Lemma 32.10.1, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01ZM . Integrality descent is proved directly from flat local stalk injections and topological irreducibility. This is not the remaining global alteration or semistable-reduction theorem.

title: Serialize an actual tracked multiplier result
author: @marwahaha
source: The first phase is the accepted exact run from the tracked multiplier return through output normalization, rewind, and bit-counted head positioning. The output tape of the tracked shift machine is proved to be the product word, so splitting it at L supplies the serializer's prefix, remaining source, and required head position. The accepted concrete emit-frame and serializer-run results then finish the serialization.

The ordinary member/survivor branches exclude complete substituted benefits requiring alternative s87(3)(a) treatment, and do not by themselves implement all of sections 87–92, section 91 special service rules or s92 commutation disregard. title: GMP member top-up only from commencement
author: @WillR
source: Original explicitly specified UK pension scheme model. Pension Schemes Act 1993 s109: full annual post-1988 GMP statutory order with cap of 3%, effective 6 April after the GMP becomes payable, without first-period pro-rating; no corresponding statutory increase to pre-1988 GMP. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1993/48/section/109. HMRC GMP first-increase guidance: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/provide-a-pension-for-your-scheme-member. Section 110 sets GMP increase funding restrictions and Pensions Act 1995 s53 provides permitted reductions for other increases; not all are modelled. Anti-franking statutory sections 87-92 are NOT fully implemented: the protected-excess floor is an externally supplied illustrative minimum, not a legal certification. GMP payable date, scheme-specific pre-GPD revaluation, survivor eligibility/amounts and calendar-date inputs must be independently verified for each scheme.

source: Original explicitly specified UK pension scheme model. Pension Schemes Act 1993 s109: full annual post-1988 GMP statutory order with cap of 3%, effective 6 April after the GMP becomes payable, without first-period pro-rating; no corresponding statutory increase to pre-1988 GMP. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1993/48/section/109. Anti-franking statutory sections 87-92 are NOT fully implemented: the protected-excess floor is an externally supplied illustrative minimum, not a legal certification. GMP payable date, scheme-specific pre-GPD revaluation, survivor eligibility/amounts and calendar-date inputs must be independently verified for each scheme.

HMRC GMP first-increase guidance: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/provide-a-pension-for-your-scheme-member. Section 110 sets GMP increase funding restrictions and Pensions Act 1995 s53 provides permitted reductions for other increases; not all are modelled. Anti-franking statutory sections 87-92 are NOT fully implemented: the protected-excess floor is an externally supplied illustrative minimum, not a legal certification. GMP payable date, scheme-specific pre-GPD revaluation, survivor eligibility/amounts and calendar-date inputs must be independently verified for each scheme.

title: Prevent double allocation of section 53 credit
author: @WillR
source: Original derived statutory UK DB benefit contracts based on Pension Schemes Act 1993 sections 87–92 (including statutory relevant sum, appropriate addition, later earnings addition and exclusions), https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1993/48/part/IV/chapter/III; and Pensions Act 1995 section 53 (next-year above-statutory credit and full deemed increase), https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1995/26/section/53. Historic cessation-date definitions and GMP age, s88 pension-at-cessation or short service benefits, s89 additional accrual and postponement enhancements, and the s90(3) assumed earnings/GMP inputs must be certified member-by-member. The ordinary member/survivor branches exclude complete substituted benefits requiring alternative s87(3)(a) treatment, and do not by themselves implement all of sections 87–92, section 91 special service rules or s92 commutation disregard. Monetary inputs are weekly unless explicitly converted, and section 53 credits are already certified amounts.

title: Gaussian Neumann corrections vanish on the nonpositive half-line
author: @WillR
source: For x≤0 the causal interval Ioc(0,x) is empty. Every weighted Gaussian Neumann correction beyond Q0 is defined by an integral on this interval and therefore vanishes. Alongside the proved head and tail recurrences for positive x, this supplies the nonpositive case needed to establish the full-function hstep identity in causal_neumann_resolvent_dominated_convergence.

title: Construct an independent exponential observation clock on a genuine joint probability space
author: @WillR
source: Pinned Mathlib already constructs `ProbabilityTheory.expMeasure p` and proves it is a probability for p>0. Its product with the supplied probability P is a probability by `Measure.prod.instIsProbabilityMeasure`, and `Measure.fst_prod` / `Measure.snd_prod` establish the two exact marginals. This is the first concrete step to form the independent exponential stopping horizon without assuming a nonexistent global Esscher-tilted Lévy process.

title: Pathwise factorisation of the exponential two-horizon Lévy increment
author: @WillR
source: Use the pathwise telescoping identity for a two-horizon increment, distribute the Laplace parameter over the sum, and apply exp(a+b)=exp(a)exp(b). This factorisation is independent of optional stopping and is reusable in conditional Markov calculations.

author: @WillR
source: Positive x belongs to Ioc(0,x) and inherits the proved local uniform geometric estimate. At x≤0 all n≥1 corrections vanish and Q0=1/a, so the fixed nonnegative constant 1/a is a pointwise geometric majorant. This closes the pointwise bound hypothesis of causal_geometric_neumann_resolvent.

title: Protected-excess floor, not full anti-franking
author: @WillR
source: Original explicitly specified UK pension scheme model. Pension Schemes Act 1993 s109: full annual post-1988 GMP statutory order with cap of 3%, effective 6 April after the GMP becomes payable, without first-period pro-rating; no corresponding statutory increase to pre-1988 GMP. https://www.legislation.gov.uk/ukpga/1993/48/section/109. HMRC GMP first-increase guidance: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/provide-a-pension-for-your-scheme-member. Section 110 sets GMP increase funding restrictions and Pensions Act 1995 s53 provides permitted reductions for other increases; not all are modelled. Anti-franking statutory sections 87-92 are NOT fully implemented: the protected-excess floor is an externally supplied illustrative minimum, not a legal certification. GMP payable date, scheme-specific pre-GPD revaluation, survivor eligibility/amounts and calendar-date inputs must be independently verified for each scheme.

title: Joint measurability of the genuine clamped-time Esscher likelihood from joint Lévy state measurability
author: @WillR
source: The positive-part clock Real.toNNReal is Borel measurable, its real coercion is measurable, and the corresponding state (ω,s)↦X_(Real.toNNReal s)(ω) is measurable by composing the input joint-state evaluation with a product of the two measurable projections. Scalar multiplication, subtraction, Real.exp and ENNReal.ofReal preserve measurability. The only remaining condition is genuine joint measurability of the Lévy state, not a tautological density assumption.
